title: Unbounded torsion-coefficient proper/open interchange with its canonical maps
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. All schemes are Noetherian, that is, admit finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale sites and their unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Consider a commutative square
$$Q=\begin{array}{ccc} U&\xrightarrow{k}&V\\ r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ W&\xrightarrow{i}&Z\end{array},\qquad pk=ir,$$
where $p,r$ are proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $i,k$ are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]; the square need not be cartesian. Write $Dj_!$ for degreewise extension by zero on the derived categories [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact], and $Rh_*$ for total right derived direct image computed with K-injective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions, lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\Gamma_Q:Di_!Rr_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*Dk_!.$$
Its specified map on a K-injective representative $J$ of $K\in D(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, with a K-injective resolution $k_!J\to I$, is represented by
$$i_!r_*J\xrightarrow{\sim}p_*k_!J\longrightarrow p_*I.$$
The first isomorphism is the canonical sheaf proper-support identification: $i_!r_*F$ and $p_*k_!F$ are the same subsheaf of $(ir)_*F=(pk)_*F$, via the support-composition identifications of [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition].

For cartesian $Q$ [def-pc-fibre-product], write
$$\lambda_Q:i^*Rp_*Dk_!\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{p,i}}Rr_*k^*Dk_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rr_*,$$
where $\operatorname{Ex}_{p,i}$ is the unbounded adjunction-mate exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] and the last map is the inverse of the open unit. Then $\Gamma_Q$ is the adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$ under the open adjunction $Di_!\dashv i^*$ obtained by termwise descent of [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy, lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]: explicitly $\Gamma_Q=\varepsilon_i\circ Di_!(\lambda_Q^{-1})$.

For vertically stacked squares $Q_1,Q_2$ with left proper maps $r_1,r_2$, right proper maps $p_1,p_2$, top open $k_1$, middle open $i_1$ and bottom open $i_2$, the specified maps satisfy
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(Rp_{2,*}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}Rr_{1,*}).$$
For horizontally adjacent squares $Q_1,Q_2$ with proper vertical maps $r,p,q$, top opens $k,l$ and bottom opens $i,j$, they satisfy
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}Dk_!)\circ(Dj_!\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
Insert the canonical direct-image composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] and open-extension composition isomorphisms [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition] in these equations. Squares with both proper maps identities or both open maps identities give the identity comparison.

For any $b:Z_1\to Z$ with Noetherian source, let $Q_1$ be the fibre-product base change of $Q$; write $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ for the projections, and $p_1,r_1,i_1,k_1$ for the new edges. Put $e_i:b^*Di_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Di_{1!}c^*$ and $e_k:a^*Dk_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Dk_{1!}d^*$, the inverses of the degreewise maps of [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map], identified by [lem-cbc-extension-zero-base-change]. With the unbounded exchanges of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange],
$$(Rp_{1,*}e_k)\circ(\operatorname{Ex}_{p,b}Dk_!)\circ(b^*\Gamma_Q)
=(\Gamma_{Q_1}d^*)\circ(Di_{1!}\operatorname{Ex}_{r,c})\circ(e_iRr_*).$$
All these assertions hold for every unbounded input complex, without constructibility, any invertibility of $|A|$, or a dimension bound on the schemes.
